strokeContrast: very thin horizontal against heavy vertical, but hairlines must survive 360 px preview
terminals: sharp triangular wedge and selectively extended blade-like ends
posture: stable baseline with slight right-upward directional energy
edge: clean with controlled sharp cuts; no brush dry texture
spacing: tight non-colliding, -2 to +3 percent of glyph width

effect.shadow: soft dark neutral, down-right 3-5 percent of glyph height, modest opacity

linePolicy: two separate transparent line layers; cover layout controls position and color
